q_definition: radians(5) * accepted ground-plane ego distance / physical transverse box span
physical_width_convention: Full 3D GT box span projected onto the horizontal unit direction perpendicular to the LIDAR_TOP ego-position-to-GT ground-plane ray; includes length/width orientation and any height contribution under roll/pitch. nuScenes size=[width,length,height], local x=length, y=width, z=height.
other_bins: unchanged published distance, pixel-width and fixed r_rot5 bins
primary_curve_summary: arithmetic average of D at sigma1..5; each grid scale equally weighted; not a continuous-dose integral
contrasts: All supported adjacent risk-ordered bins plus prespecified high-risk versus low-risk endpoints within each conditioning stratum; inverse width and positive q/r/distance order.
trend: Strict monotonic D ordering across all supported bins; one- and zero-cell strata are not testable. Report all sigma and curve average, not only 5 degrees.
crossover: Retain original observed upward brackets; supplemental first positive observed sigma that stays positive through sigma5. Clean benefit must be positive. Never-positive is right-censored beyond5, not a measured sigma6. Bootstrap earlier/tie/later shares reported conditional on both clean benefits positive.
sensitivity: Same paired scene draws plus 5 seed indices sampled with replacement independently per sigma, shared across all cells/variables within each replicate. Conditional on only five observed realizations; not full perturbation-distribution uncertainty.
incremental: Five scene-held-out folds. OLS main effects of five distance bins versus distance plus four fixed indicator bins; distance+q+r included to test incremental r beyond q. Same common valid objects, folds and five-dimensional D targets averaged over seeds. Score per-object squared error averaged across sigma. No interactions, regularization or tuning. Paired scene bootstrap of fixed out-of-fold loss differences; no refitting inside bootstrap. This assesses D, not crossover prediction.
